tools.name: quote_conversion
tools.description: Show the credit price of converting an image to editable PowerPoint and/or SVG, and the account balance. Free; nothing is charged.

tools.name: convert_image
tools.description: Convert a PNG, JPEG or WebP image into an editable PowerPoint (.pptx) and/or SVG and return download links. Spends credits only when files are delivered (SVG 1, PowerPoint 2); a failed conversion is not charged. Waits up to about 45 seconds; if still running, returns conversion_id for get_conversion

tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: Check the status, progress and download links of a conversion started with convert_image. Free.
